source.inputs: Four generated views (front, three-quarter, side, rear) cropped from docs/frontend/3d-object/images/modular-sofa-grey-turnaround.png
source.postProcessing: Uniform scale 1.421434 and a floor-pivot translation applied through an inserted root node; the BIN chunk and its embedded textures are byte-identical to the provider output.

knownLimitations: Dimensions are the generator's own proportions after uniform scaling to 270 cm wide, not the 270 x 100 x 67 cm target. It came out about 14 percent taller and 14 percent shallower than intended; proportions were deliberately not distorted to fit the target.
10.31 MB exceeds the 5 MB per-product budget in the collaborator handoff, because the provider embeds four full-resolution texture maps.
Single merged mesh with one material: individual cushions and feet are not separately addressable.
Geometry has not been inspected in Blender; underside and seam quality are unverified.
